contract.intent: Produce the system-design doc for Ann (type system-design): components & ownership, data model, boundaries/interfaces, failure modes, scale assumptions — the technique layer. Upstream: 01-goal/01-grilling/artifacts/ann-spec.md (locked).
acceptanceCriteria: Components listed, each with a one-line job and an owner (what does each component refuse to do?)
Data model defined: StepNode, artifacts, checkpoints, trace — who writes, who reads, stale-read behavior, empty-record decision
Shared schemas frozen at interfaces (StepNode JSON schema, context packet schema, binding API) — the boundaries that keep components independent
Failure modes per component: fail-closed vs fail-open is an explicit decision; the one failure that would wreck the product is named
Scale assumptions stated (tree size, write rate, fixture suite size)
Q1-Q4 resolved or explicitly parked with defaults (runtime, provider, storage, UI)

openQuestions.question: Runtime/language for the implementation?
openQuestions.reason: Affects every slice; a fresh agent would get it wrong without an answer
openQuestions.defaultIfUnanswered: Node.js + TypeScript (original skeleton; mature agent/LLM ecosystem)

openQuestions.question: Model provider to start with?
openQuestions.reason: Design §16 is adapter-based, but the first adapter must be chosen
openQuestions.defaultIfUnanswered: Adapter-first; first adapter = whatever provider is configured locally (OpenAI-compatible)

openQuestions.question: Storage backend for the tree + branch checkpoints?
openQuestions.reason: Spec §9 parks checkpoint mechanics here; choice shapes the core API
openQuestions.defaultIfUnanswered: SQLite (better-sqlite3) for tree/index + JSON artifact files on disk

openQuestions.question: UI form factor for v1?
openQuestions.reason: Spec §3 names agent-executed CLI as primary flow; one surface must be confirmed
openQuestions.defaultIfUnanswered: CLI + tree artifacts on disk (tree view + step cards + full plan renders)
